summary.headline: Mars Cuts Off the Conjunction
summary.text: Astrological judgment explaining how Mars destroyed the matter by cutting off the conjunction between the Sun and Saturn, despite the Sun receiving the disposition from the ascendant lord and Moon and standing between the midheaven lord and ascendant lord.
